product_rules_bps_range.name: product_rules_bps_range
product_rules_bps_range.value: "product_rules"."below_moq_surcharge_bps" between 0 and 100000 and "product_rules"."rush_surcharge_bps" between 0 and 100000 and "product_rules"."priority_rush_surcharge_bps" between 0 and 100000

checkouts_owner.name: checkouts_owner
checkouts_owner.value: num_nonnulls("checkouts"."owner_user_id", "checkouts"."owner_device_hash") = 1 or ("checkouts"."status" <> 'OPEN' and "checkouts"."owner_user_id" is null and "checkouts"."owner_device_hash" is null)

generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(title, '') || ' ' || coalesce(phrases_text, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(summary, '')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(body_text, '')), 'C')

proof_comments_pin_range.name: proof_comments_pin_range
proof_comments_pin_range.value: "proof_comments"."pin_x" is null or ("proof_comments"."pin_x" between 0 and 1 and "proof_comments"."pin_y" between 0 and 1)

allowance_policies_period.name: allowance_policies_period
allowance_policies_period.value: "allowance_policies"."kind" <> 'PER_PERIOD' or ("allowance_policies"."period" is not null and "allowance_policies"."renews_on" is not null)
